meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列开展结合与稳定性实验,取回测定结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做蛋白工程实验,想要一套清晰的送检与结果获取指南。
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then retrieve results.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Adaptyv Foundry API 和 Python SDK 帮你查靶点、估算费用、创建并提交蛋白实验,之后再取回实验结果。它会从环境变量 ADAPTYV_API_KEY 读取密钥,不把 token 写进代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白结合实验等关键词,或代码里出现 adaptyv、FoundryClient 时触发;也可用于把蛋白序列提交做实验表征。

say.text: 帮我查一下可自助的 EGFR 靶点,并估算这组序列的筛选费用
say.note: 会列出靶点并返回费用估算

say.text: 把这批序列建成一个 BLI 筛选实验并提交审核

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Adaptyv Foundry API and Python SDK to browse targets, estimate cost, create and submit protein experiments, then retrieve results. It reads the key from ADAPTYV_API_KEY.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Adaptyv, Foundry API, or protein binding assays, or when code imports adaptyv, adaptyv_sdk, or FoundryClient.
